sections.title: Industrializing DePIN Profitability
sections.body: The theory of DePIN is compelling, but the reality is won through operational efficiency. These case studies highlight how Kenya AI Compute is transforming the economics of decentralized networks. For example, a managed GPU cluster operating on Render Network within our facility achieved a 65% higher net margin compared to a similar setup in the European Union, purely due to the disparity in electricity costs. Another study of our CPU nodes on the Akash marketplace shows that our Tier II+ reliability allows our operators to win 30% more auctions than residential-based nodes. These success stories provide the 'Proof of Profit' for institutional investors looking to move from crypto-speculation into infrastructure-based token earnings. Additional context: the project follows a clear rollout roadmap that aligns low-cost energy, infrastructure reliability, and flexible deployment models. Each phase includes checkpoints on capacity, uptime, and unit econ
